title: festuca fragilis
intro: Festuca fragilis, commonly known as Fragile Fescue, is a type of grass species belonging to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Festuca fragilis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing oxidative stress and modulating the immune system.
